json.task: Use KnowBe4 to build and maintain security awareness across an organization.
benefits: Training content is clear, up-to-date, and easy to understand.
Phishing simulations and short modules reinforce security practices non-disruptively.
Platform facilitates progress tracking and builds overall security awareness.
Provides a structured program to reduce phishing-related incidents and risky behavior.
frictions: Some training modules can feel repetitive over time.
Certain simulations may not always reflect the most recent real-world scenarios.
